about: Modwerk source-only scene-mutes package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/scene-mutes.

mods.title: Scene Mutes
mods.summary: Each scene can carry its own track mutes: engage the scene and the mutes change with it.
mods.description: In scene edit, FUNC + T1..T13 builds the edited scene's mute mask (T13 is FX), shown on the trig keys while FUNC is held. Engaging a marked scene sets the mutes; an unmarked scene, or none, puts back the mutes from before. CLEAR and CLEAR ALL also drop the masks. Scenes engaged from the pads were tested on a unit; CC 92, NRPN and Overbridge should work, not tested. A port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0018-scene-mutes, with his code unchanged.
mods.author: Iced-Cream
mods.on_unit: On an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 (run T210, the Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7 with this module), engaging a scene from its pad with T1 and T2 in its mask silenced BD and SD while RS and CH played, disengaging brought them back, a hand mute while engaged was kept, the mask survived a power cycle and CLEAR dropped it. CC 92, NRPN and Overbridge engage were not tested. This package's own bytes have not been flashed from the site.
